Title I would amend the Medicaid program to promote access to mental health services in communities and schools. Section 11001 would expand Medicaid’s Certified Community
Behavioral Health Clinics demonstration by allowing all states and the District of Columbia to participate in the demonstration. (Under current law nine states are authorized to implement
the demonstration.) The provision would permit new states to operate their demonstrations for four years and, for the nine states currently partcipating, increase the number of years they
can operate their demonstrations. CBO estimates that the provision would increase direct spending because payment rates for services provided in certified community behavioral health
clinics would be higher under the demonstration than under current law.
Sec. 12004 would codify the prohibition of straw purchasing and trafficking of firearms and enhance penalties.
